notes.style: A single 1970s-inflected tailoring silhouette defines the house.
notes.craft: Every Husbands PDP sampled states a country of make (Italy, Poland, Portugal) and the fabric's country of origin, but none names a maker or mill. Suit PDPs give construction specifics ('entièrement entoilée', functional cuffs). The only maker reference is an unnamed 1989 Cologne shirt workshop. That is country-of-make plus construction detail = 2 (a strong 2).

cities: Sold direct, through its own site only

craft_evidence.owned_d: No owned atelier or factory claimed. The Histoire page speaks only of 'Authentic fabrics and savoir-faire' with no place named. Shirt PDPs say 'Nos chemises sont fabriquées dans un atelier fondé en 1989 à Cologne, en Allemagne' - an unnamed third-party workshop, not claimed as owned (and the two shirts read are themselves 'fabriqué en Pologne').
craft_evidence.countries: Italy 2/6 (navy serge suit, cashmere roll-neck), Poland 2/6 (two cotton-silk shirts), Portugal 2/6 (flared trouser, ringer tee). Sample of 6 rendered PDPs: suit, knit, 2 shirts, trousers, tee. products.json body text does not carry the origin; it is on the rendered PDP.
